sorular.soru: Who is a Companion?
secenekler: A) A close relative of the Prophet ﷺ
B) Anyone who memorized the Quran
C) A person who saw the Prophet ﷺ, believed in him, and died as a Muslim
D) One of the first four caliphs
sorular.aciklama: A Companion is a person who saw the Prophet ﷺ, believed in him, and died upon that faith.

sorular.soru: Which approach is not recommended when reading about the lives of the Companions?
secenekler: A) Understanding their choices in their own context
B) Drawing inspiration from their lives
C) Recognizing that different characters represent different virtues
D) Seeing them as superhuman beings
sorular.aciklama: The Companions were not superhuman; they were individuals who made mistakes, grew, and made choices like ordinary people. The aim is to follow their example, not turn them into legends.

sorular.soru: What was Abu Bakr's most distinguishing quality?
secenekler: A) His loyalty and his affirmation of the Messenger of Allah without hesitation
B) His physical strength
C) His military victories
D) His long life
sorular.aciklama: Abu Bakr's title 'as-Siddiq' (the one who affirms the truth often) comes from his loyalty in affirming the Messenger of Allah without hesitation.

sorular.soru: How did Abu Bakr support Muslims who were tortured for their faith?
secenekler: A) By assuming military leadership
B) By forming a large army
C) By buying and freeing enslaved people who were being tortured
D) By writing books
sorular.aciklama: Abu Bakr supported his faith with his wealth by buying and freeing enslaved people such as Bilal, who were tortured for believing.

sorular.soru: Which statement best sums up the two contrasting sides of Umar's character?
secenekler: A) Generosity and frugality
B) Silence and talkativeness
C) Courage and cowardice
D) A stern temperament and submission to the truth
sorular.aciklama: Umar appeared stern and strong on the outside, but he was exceptionally humble and submissive to the truth.

sorular.soru: What was Umar's most important distinguishing quality in Islamic history?
secenekler: A) His justice and determination in governing the state
B) His being the longest-serving caliph
C) His memorizing the most verses
D) His being the first Muslim
sorular.aciklama: Umar is remembered in history as an exemplary leader who combined justice, strong leadership, and submission to the truth.

sorular.soru: What was one of Uthman's greatest contributions to Islam?
secenekler: A) Starting the first jihad
B) Building the first mosque
C) Arranging for copies of the Quran to be made and sent to various cities
D) Resolving disputes among the Companions
sorular.aciklama: Uthman had copies of the Quran made and sent them throughout the Muslim world; through this service, he made a great contribution to preserving the Quran.

sorular.soru: Which two virtues stand out among Uthman's personal qualities?
secenekler: A) Courage and strength
B) Modesty and generosity
C) Intelligence and strategic thinking
D) Patience and silence
sorular.aciklama: Uthman was modest and exceptionally generous; he spent his wealth for the cause of Islam without hesitation.

sorular.soru: What were Ali's two most distinguishing qualities?
secenekler: A) Patience and humility
B) Generosity and modesty
C) Truthfulness and loyalty
D) Knowledge and courage
sorular.aciklama: Ali is known for his courage in embracing faith at a young age and for his deep knowledge.

sorular.soru: What is Khadijah's special place in Islamic history?
secenekler: A) She was the first person to believe and comforted the Messenger of Allah on his most difficult day
B) She was the first woman to write down the Quran
C) She was the first woman to migrate
D) She was the woman who narrated the most hadiths
sorular.aciklama: Khadijah was the first person to believe and comforted the Messenger of Allah at the overwhelming moment when revelation first descended.

sorular.soru: In what way is Aishah's contribution to Islamic knowledge most notable?
secenekler: A) She commissioned the writing of the first copy of the Quran
B) She commanded major battles
C) She narrated many hadiths and taught knowledge to the Companions and their successors
D) She founded the first madrasa
sorular.aciklama: Aishah is among the Companions who narrated the most hadiths, and both Companions and their successors learned from her.

sorular.soru: What is Bilal al-Habashi's symbolic significance in Islamic history?
secenekler: A) He was the first Companion to be martyred
B) He was the first Companion to migrate
C) He was the Companion who narrated the most hadiths
D) He preserved his faith despite severe torture and became the first muezzin
sorular.aciklama: Bilal held fast to the oneness of Allah on the scorching sand, saying 'Ahad! Ahad!', and later became the first muezzin of the Prophet's Mosque.

sorular.soru: What do the words Bilal spoke under torture mean?
secenekler: A) "May Allah save us"
B) "Allah is One" — the essence of belief in His oneness
C) "Patience is beautiful"
D) "I am not afraid of you"
sorular.aciklama: 'Ahad! Ahad!' is a declaration that Allah is One; it is an expression of iman in its purest form.

sorular.soru: What was Mus'ab ibn Umayr's role in Islamic history?
secenekler: A) Bringing Islam to Medina and serving as the first envoy
B) Being elected the first caliph
C) Making the first copies of the Quran
D) Forming a large army
sorular.aciklama: Mus'ab was a young Companion raised in a wealthy family; he left his family behind, brought Islam to Medina, and was martyred at Uhud.

sorular.soru: In which battle was Mus'ab ibn Umayr martyred?
secenekler: A) The Battle of Badr
B) The Battle of the Trench
C) The Battle of Uhud
D) The Battle of Mu'tah
sorular.aciklama: Mus'ab ibn Umayr was martyred at the Battle of Uhud without letting the banner fall from his hand.

sorular.soru: What was Salman al-Farisi's most distinguishing quality before he came to Islam?
secenekler: A) Being a wealthy merchant
B) Having a large army
C) Being a good farmer
D) Searching for the truth for years and learning about different religions
sorular.aciklama: Salman set out from Persia in search of the truth; he encountered various religions and communities and eventually reached the Messenger of Allah.

sorular.soru: What was Salman al-Farisi's contribution to the Battle of the Trench?
secenekler: A) Commanding the army
B) Proposing the idea of digging a trench
C) Leading negotiations
D) Capturing enemy spies
sorular.aciklama: At the Battle of the Trench, the trench strategy proposed by Salman strengthened the Muslims' defense against a vastly outnumbering enemy.

sorular.soru: What was Abdurrahman ibn Awf's distinguishing quality?
secenekler: A) Spending the wealth he earned through halal means in the cause of Allah
B) His military genius
C) His long life
D) Teaching many students
sorular.aciklama: Abdurrahman ibn Awf achieved success in trade through halal means and spent generously in the cause of Allah.

sorular.soru: What was the most difficult test of Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas's faith?
secenekler: A) Enduring torture
B) Taking command in a major battle
C) His mother refusing to eat in order to make him abandon his faith
D) Being imprisoned for many years
sorular.aciklama: Sa'd's mother went on a hunger strike to make her son abandon Islam; although Sa'd loved his mother, he did not compromise his faith.

sorular.soru: What notable action did Talha ibn Ubaydullah take unconsciously at the Battle of Uhud?
secenekler: A) Carrying the banner
B) Killing the enemy commander
C) Rallying the retreating soldiers
D) Protecting the Messenger of Allah with his life and using his body as a shield
sorular.aciklama: At Uhud, when the ranks were breaking apart, Talha shielded the Messenger of Allah and suffered many wounds to his body.

sorular.soru: What was notable about Zubayr ibn al-Awwam's acceptance of Islam?
secenekler: A) He came to Islam as an adult
B) Embracing Islam at a very young age and his courage
C) Being the first Muslim in Medina
D) Taking part in many battles
sorular.aciklama: Zubayr embraced Islam at a young age and stood out for his courage.

sorular.soru: What was Muadh ibn Jabal's place among the Companions?
secenekler: A) A great scholar who knew that knowledge brings responsibility
B) The strongest warrior
C) The Companion who donated the most wealth
D) The first muezzin
sorular.aciklama: Muadh ibn Jabal was a Companion who bore his knowledge with a sense of responsibility and demonstrated through his life what it means to possess knowledge.

sorular.soru: What was Ubayy ibn Ka'b's important contribution to Islamic culture?
secenekler: A) Establishing a large army
B) Financing the construction of the first mosque
C) Being among those who knew the Quran best and teaching it
D) Spreading Islam as a merchant
sorular.aciklama: Ubayy ibn Ka'b was among the Companions who knew the Quran best, and it is known that the Messenger of Allah recommended reciting the Quran to him.

sorular.soru: Why was Asma bint Abu Bakr given the title 'Dhat an-Nitaqayn' (the woman of two belts)?
secenekler: A) She lived long enough to see two different generations
B) She had two sons
C) She migrated twice
D) She split her belt in two while carrying food to the Messenger of Allah and her father during the migration
sorular.aciklama: While preparing for the migration, Asma split her belt in two to tie up the food; for this reason, she was given the title 'the woman of two belts.'

sorular.soru: What was Asma bint Abu Bakr's role during the migration?
secenekler: A) Planning to mislead those pursuing the Messenger of Allah
B) Carrying food and keeping a secret
C) Delivering news to the people in Medina
D) Guiding the migration caravan
sorular.aciklama: During the migration, Asma carried food to the Messenger of Allah and her father, kept a secret under pressure, and showed courage.

sorular.soru: What notable action did Umm Umarah take at the Battle of Uhud?
secenekler: A) Protecting the Messenger of Allah as the ranks fell into disarray
B) Carrying water to the wounded
C) Attacking the enemy ranks
D) Burying the martyrs after the battle
sorular.aciklama: Umm Umarah was one of the few people who stayed beside the Messenger of Allah and protected him when the ranks fell into great disarray at Uhud.

sorular.soru: Why is Umm Umarah's example important to the Islamic understanding?
secenekler: A) It shows that women are obliged to take part in battle
B) It proves that women are superior to men
C) It shows that responsibility depends on iman and courage, not gender
D) It shows that war is only for defensive purposes
sorular.aciklama: Umm Umarah's example shows that responsibility and courage are matters of iman, not gender.

sorular.soru: What is the purpose of considering the different characters of the Companions together?
secenekler: A) To show the rivalry between them
B) To show that each represents a different virtue and that everyone can find a role model suited to them
C) To choose the best among them
D) To give their historical order
sorular.aciklama: The Companions offer examples whose different personalities complement one another: courageous, learned, generous, loyal, patient... Each represents a different light.

sorular.soru: On what basis did Abu Bakr become the first caliph?
secenekler: A) Through his military strength
B) Through the written will of the Messenger of Allah
C) Because he was the oldest Companion
D) Through the choice of the Companions and his loyalty
sorular.aciklama: After the death of the Messenger of Allah, Abu Bakr became the first caliph, with the Companions united in their choice of him; his loyalty and trustworthy character were decisive in that choice.

sorular.soru: Why is Bilal al-Habashi's story as a Companion especially meaningful?
secenekler: A) It shows that someone of the lowest social status can rise to the highest rank through iman
B) He came from a noble family
C) He was martyred at a very young age
D) He was the Companion who took part in the most battles
sorular.aciklama: Bilal began life as a slave; through his iman, patience, and voice, he became the first muezzin in Islamic history. Iman comes before social status.

sorular.soru: Which mistaken approach should be avoided when reading about the lives of the Companions?
secenekler: A) Seeing their mistakes as a human reality
B) Drawing lessons to apply to our own lives
C) Seeing them as perfect beings who never made mistakes
D) Recognizing that different personalities represent different virtues
sorular.aciklama: The essential approach is to see the Companions as real people and draw inspiration from their lives, rather than turning them into legends.

sorular.soru: What kind of life did Mus'ab ibn Umayr lead before going to Medina?
secenekler: A) A poor shepherd
B) A wealthy and spoiled young man
C) A slave
D) A farmer
sorular.aciklama: Mus'ab grew up in one of the wealthiest families in Mecca and was known for his clothes and lifestyle. His iman led him to risk everything.

sorular.soru: How did Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas respond to pressure from his mother?
secenekler: A) He left the faith in accordance with his mother's wishes
B) He abandoned his mother and never saw her again
C) He invited his mother to Islam and persuaded her
D) He maintained his iman despite loving his mother and continued to treat her kindly
sorular.aciklama: Sa'd never denied his love for his mother, but he did not compromise his devotion to Allah either. The balance between the two reflects his character.

sorular.soru: What was the essence of Khadijah's words to the Messenger of Allah when revelation first came to him?
secenekler: A) You are an honest person; Allah will not disgrace you
B) I do not support you; be thoughtful
C) This is the work of a devil
D) Let us leave Mecca immediately
sorular.aciklama: Khadijah reassured the Messenger of Allah, who was experiencing the shock of the first revelation, saying, 'You honor what is entrusted to you and speak truthfully; Allah will never disgrace you.'

sorular.soru: What is especially notable about Salman al-Farisi's place in Islamic history?
secenekler: A) He was the longest-living Companion
B) He narrated the most hadiths
C) The first non-Arab Companion made an important contribution to Islam
D) He owned the most land
sorular.aciklama: Salman was Persian and represents the fact that Islam recognizes no ethnic boundaries and accepts those who seek the truth.

sorular.soru: What was Aishah's importance in the teaching of religious knowledge?
secenekler: A) She taught only women
B) Many people from both the Companions and the next generation learned from her
C) She was known only for her Quranic commentary
D) She founded the first madrasa
sorular.aciklama: Aishah was one of the greatest authorities on religious knowledge of her time; many people from both the Companions and the next generation came to her to learn.

sorular.soru: What did Talhah ibn Ubaydullah and Zubayr ibn al-Awwam have in common?
secenekler: A) Both were candidates to become the first caliph
B) Both were among the first to memorize the Quran
C) Both preached Islam in Medina
D) Both showed remarkable courage at Uhud
sorular.aciklama: Both showed great courage at the Battle of Uhud and tried to protect the Messenger of Allah with their lives.

sorular.soru: What is the right way to draw inspiration from the Companions?
secenekler: A) To consider which virtues we can put into practice in our own circumstances and how
B) To imitate their every word and action exactly
C) Following only the first four caliphs as examples
D) Reading many books about them
sorular.aciklama: Drawing inspiration from the Companions involves asking how we can put their virtues into practice in today's circumstances.
